name: list_scorers
description: Return the live catalog of MLflow built-in judge scorers by introspecting mlflow.genai.scorers at runtime. The agent MUST call this before submit_eval_job whenever the user provides scorer names in plain English (e.g. 'faithfulness', 'answer relevance', 'correctness') — match the user's vocabulary against the returned {name, doc} list using the docstring text, then pass ONLY canonical `name` values verbatim to submit_eval_job. If the semantic match is ambiguous (two scorers look like plausible fits, or no scorer clearly matches), prompt the user to disambiguate; do NOT guess. The SageMaker eval container accepts canonical names only and will raise a ValueError listing valid names on any unknown input.

name: query_metrics
description: Fetch all metrics for a specific MLflow run by run ID.

name: retrieve_traces
description: List recent MLflow runs for an experiment, with status and metrics summary.

name: analyze_trace
description: Return full run data (params, metrics, tags, status) for a single MLflow run.

name: generate_compliance_report
description: Render a compliance report for a completed LLM evaluation run. Caller (compliance-documentation skill) authors the narrative (title, sections, findings); this tool writes markdown + .docx to S3 and stamps the thread row's eval job entry with compliance_report_s3_uri / compliance_report_format / compliance_report_at. Auto-appends the worst N failing rows from the run's eval_results.parquet artifact when appendix_failing_rows is omitted.

thread_id.description: Thread ID (PK of the DynamoDB thread row). Always pass CURRENT_THREAD_ID.

job_id.description: Eval job_id from submit_eval_job — identifies the jobs.<job_id> map entry to stamp.

run_id.description: MLflow run ID the report describes. Used to pull metrics and the eval_results.parquet appendix.

sections.description: Ordered narrative sections. Each {heading, body} pair becomes an H2 in the markdown and a Heading 1 in the .docx.

findings.description: Pass/fail findings. Rendered as coloured PASS/FAIL/?? tags in the .docx.

metrics.description: Metric name → value. Rendered as a two-column Metrics Summary table.

appendix_failing_rows.description: Override the auto-pulled worst-N appendix with explicit rows. Omit in the normal case.

out_s3_prefix.description: S3 prefix for the report artifacts (default: compliance-reports/<thread_id>/<job_id>)
